paper_title: New Constraints on ALP Electron and Photon Couplings from ArgoNeuT and the MiniBooNE Beam Dump
notes: Paper presents new constraints on ALP-electron (gae) and ALP-photon (gagamma) couplings from MiniBooNE dump-mode data, plus ArgoNeuT projections. The pre-analysis hint of AxionElectron is one of two main results (Fig. 8 for gae, Fig. 7 for gaphoton). Limits given at 2 sigma (~95% CL). Data points are approximate readings from the gae exclusion contour (Fig. 8) since no numerical table is provided; values estimated from text descriptions (resonant peak near ma~10-16 MeV reaching gae~3e-8, undulating features 10-30 MeV). The MiniBooNE limit ranges roughly ma=10^4 to 10^8 eV.
